# Noise-Rate-Activated Sensing

> Optimal sensing of a Hamiltonian frequency under a fixed unknown transverse error direction. Bounded syndrome-conditioned rate control changes the attainable precision law.

## Scientific entry points
- [Overview](README.md): Central result, scope, reading routes, and purpose/contact.
- [Model](docs/MODEL.md): Allowed control, nuisance-adjusted classical information, charged time, and parameter normalization.
- [Theorems](docs/THEOREMS.md): All-strategy fixed-rate converse, exact leading controlled coefficient, general selectable settings, and independent-axis bound.
- [Stopped sensing](docs/STOPPED_SENSING.md): Exact Ramsey operation, first-passage law, deadline accounting, finite-time separation, and global estimation proof.
- [Physical scope](docs/PHYSICAL_SCOPE.md): Collision and stochastic models, coherent-access distinction, signal shifts, and finite-cadence local result.
- [Tutorial](docs/TUTORIAL.md): Self-directed explanation of the mechanism and key distinctions.
- [Related work](literature/RELATED_WORK.md): Primary-source comparisons and explicit attribution boundaries.
- [Bibliography](literature/references.bib): Machine-readable references.

## Verification and maintenance
- [Reproducibility](docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md): Commands, check coverage, and numerical example.
- [Reference calculations](src/nras.py): Algebra, control speed, timing laws, and exact event simulator.
- [Tests](tests/test_nras.py): Symbolic identities, matrix products, independent optimization, and deadline-aware simulations.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Scope, scientific invariants, and safe repository workflow.

Treat the documents as the claim definitions and proofs, not the tests as universal evidence. Keep local and global statements distinct. No bath-output access or coherent unknown-axis drive is part of the central resource model. Do not infer priority or experimental demonstration from a numerical check.
